title: Denis Mutuku
text: Denis is an epidemiologist with a strong background in public health and medical statistics. He has a diverse range of skills, including conducting quantitative and qualitative research, data management and analysis, project implementation, and monitoring and evaluation (M&E). He is passionate about improving health and well-being by generating evidence that influences policies and strategies to prevent diseases, prolong life, and promote health. As an epidemiologist, his aim is to use my analytical skills and expertise to guide evidence-based initiatives for maintaining a healthy society.
